findings.issue: No workflow runs fmt, clippy, cargo test, coverage or the Python harness; sc-lint.toml defines gates nothing invokes. Feature flags exercised only via local unification. jev-python tests never run anywhere.
findings.recommendation: PR CI on ubuntu/macos/windows: just lint, just test, clippy all-features, maturin develop + pytest; feature-matrix job for sc-treesitter.

findings.issue: sc-jev 65.0% and sc-jev-py 60.4% under 70%. Lowest: sc-jev client/https.rs 13.6% (production HTTPS transport), client/transport.rs 0%, sc-jev-py lib.rs 0%, run.rs 53.9%, error.rs 56.3%, sc-jev-backends transport.rs 33.9% (real HTTP path), sc-treesitter git_io.rs 47.6%, sc-jev-check payload/questions.rs 58.4%, sc-ai main.rs 57.9%. Real network transports are highest-risk uncovered code.
findings.recommendation: Loopback/in-process fake-server tests for both HTTPS transports (timeout, status mapping, redirect, TLS failure, Retry-After capture); pyo3 wrappers via Python harness in CI; git_io failure paths; sc-jev-py run.rs error paths.

findings.issue: Retry-After parsed twice with different semantics: sc-jev f64 (empty->1s, '1.5'->1.5s) vs backends i64 (empty->30s, '1.5'->30s).
findings.recommendation: One spec, one shared parser and BUSY set, shared table test.

findings.issue: SessionEvent->LogEvent adapter duplicated (sc-ai observe.rs:120-183 vs logging.rs:181-215); diverged: fallback action 'session' vs 'event', field order differs.
findings.recommendation: Shared adapter parameterised by service name; test both front ends emit identical fields.

findings.issue: 11 rustdoc broken intra-doc links across 6 crates (sc-agent-types secret.rs:15; sc-agent-secrets lib.rs:8,10; sc-treesitter lib.rs:4; sc-jev client/mod.rs:1; sc-jev-backends transport.rs:148; sc-jev-py run.rs:252,255,361,597,632).
findings.recommendation: Fix links; RUSTDOCFLAGS=-D warnings in CI doc step.

findings.issue: cargo test -p sc-treesitter --no-default-features fails >=10 tests (grammar tests not cfg-gated); cargo check passes for all combos; no CI exercises them.
findings.recommendation: #[cfg(feature)] gate grammar tests; feature-matrix CI; or drop the features.

findings.issue: Hand-rolled TempDir x3 (extract/mod.rs:100-120, run/exact.rs:40-57, sc-jev-py run.rs:661; sc-agent-secrets uses tempfile); git toplevel lookup x2 (sc-treesitter git_io.rs:85, sc-ai command.rs ~715); stderr error emitter x2 (sc-ai main.rs, sc-treesitter main.rs).
findings.recommendation: tempfile::TempDir everywhere; shared git-toplevel and stderr-emit helpers; move exact.rs under tests/.

findings.issue: #[allow(clippy::too_many_arguments)] x3 (run.rs:468,520,551); unguarded .expect on data at sc-agent-types payload.rs:62; invariant expects in wire.rs:237,403, observe.rs:122-181, logging.rs:183-192, sc-ai main.rs:54.
findings.recommendation: Group args into struct or justify; keep expects only where invariant is unit-tested.
